EDITORIAL
Dear readers,
2025 has been another year of quality delivery and meaningful progress for Danone. We delivered a strong +4.5%
like-for-like sales growth. And importantly, we achieved it while driving sustainability in a focused and impactful way,
because it is essential to the longterm resilience of our business.
In a volatile world, our performance reflects the strength and resilience of our unique health-focused portfolio.
Health Through Food has never been more relevant. The food industry is at a tipping point: everywhere, people increasingly
understand interconnection between what they eat and how they live. Our categories are uniquely positioned to take
advantage of it.
In 2025, we deployed Renew Danone Chapter 2 at pace: we continued doubling down on the fundamentals, while further
transforming the business. We continued strengthening the capabilities that truly differentiate Danone and kept building
differentiation through science. The cutting-edge OneBiome research Laboratory we opened in Paris-Saclay is testimony of it.
We moved to the forefront of acquisitions with the purchase of Kate Farms, first doctor-recommended plant-based brand in
the U.S. and The Akkermansia Company detaining a strain clinically demonstrated to reinforce the gut barrier.
We kept reinvesting behind our brands. Our cross categories partnership with Carlos Alcaraz is an example.
We keep investing in our people, growing the next generation of leaders. Through initiatives such as DanSkills, we are
upskilling our teams with the critical capabilities of tomorrow — from digital and AI to sustainability, science and leadership.
In 2025, we were proud of our significant progress across all targets of the three pillars of our Danone Impact Journey:
Health, Nature, and People & Communities. We have this year again the healthiest portfolio in the industry and we are
ranked #1 by the Access to Nutrition Index. We have also significantly reduced sugars in kids’ dairy and plant-based
products. We were again recognized with a Triple A rating by CDP, placing us among only 23 companies worldwide
achieving this distinction across climate change, water stewardship, and forest preservation. Achieving worldwide B
Corp certification marked another milestone, celebrating a decade-long journey and reaffirming our belief to combining
performance and positive impact.
These achievements reflect the relevance of our strategy, the dedication of our people, and the trust of our partners.
Together, we are building a healthier future—step by step, anchored in science, with purpose and impact at the core.
Thank you, to all the Danoners and to all our partners - farmers, entrepreneurs, suppliers - for making 2025 a great
milestone! And thank you to our customers and patients for trusting us every day again. Our priority has been – and will
always remain – to serve you with safe and high-quality products because trust, quality and food safety are strategic
enablers of long-term growth and resilience for Danone.
